interface.name: jd_window_health_manager_v1
interface.description: Local experimental protocol; not an upstream River API. This global has the same security restrictions as foreign toplevel inventory. Observation never closes, signals or disconnects an application. Closing a window is not evidence of responsiveness or lack thereof. An XDG ping tests whether the Wayland connection dispatches events; it cannot prove every UI thread or application operation is working. Xwayland is unsupported.

interface.name: jd_window_health_watch_v1
interface.description: The supplied foreign toplevel capability identifies the original window. A closed observer is inert. Destroying all observers ends probing. A single connection shares one native ping and its ten second timeout. State changes are sent immediately, with at most one probe per second.
